adjudication.dayCharacter: Two distinct NLC/Commons catalogued scan copies visibly include 日 in 年月日時胎: NLC 06857 第3冊 PDF p.47 (heading 福聚命印) and NLC 892-2621-209417 第4冊 PDF p.30 (heading 福聚印). Shidian record NGJ8922621209348 transcribes 年月時胎 without 日. The NLC series mapping is established, but direct provenance from the precise p.30 scan to that transcript is not; classify this as a transcript/scan discrepancy and leave cause open, not as a proven manuscript variant or OCR error.
adjudication.headingVariant: The two visually inspected NLC copies differ in the section heading: 福聚命印 (NLC 06857 第3冊 p.47) versus 福聚印 (NLC 892-2621-209417 第4冊 p.30). Both include 日 in the five-position list. No rule is promoted.
adjudication.fiveVersusFour: The NLC/Commons volume-3 facsimile confirms 五位中或四位; preserve it separately from TMTH 五位俱 and do not convert either to a generic four-of-five predicate.
adjudication.textualVariants: The same facsimile confirms 主本, 帝坐, 甲戌日得乙酉時, and 水命人…木印無益 in its copy. The first case month glyph 乙/己/已 is still unresolved on the inspected image.
adjudication.engine: Actual project engine executed on two constructed civil-date realizations; confirms calendar consistency only. No interpretive or prediction rule was promoted.
